coverage.note: Lectures 1-3. The 11 videos use 14 OCW decks whose numbering does not follow the videos; video 1 covers deck 01 alone, video 2 deck 02 alone plus its handwritten backprop-example deck, video 3 decks 03a and 03b.

license.summary: The course is published on MIT OpenCourseWare under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, and this repository is offered under the same licence. Slides carrying an OCW exclusion notice are described in prose only and never rendered into raw/images/.

figureAudit.note: decksTotal counts transcribed decks. Each was transcribed by Sonnet and checked by the parent model against 1400px renders. Lecture 1: six pages (51, 59, 80, 93, 94, 100); slide 59's sigmoid corrected. Lecture 2 deck 02: six pages (4, 33, 42, 55, 69, 79); slide 52's minimum corrected. Lecture 2 backprop example: pages 7 and 12, both agreed. Numeric tables and worked examples were also checked by arithmetic. Lecture 3 deck 3A: four pages (10, 15, 17, 18); deck 3B: three (6 on a scratch crop of its excluded tables, 16, 18). All agreed; one unprinted identification on deck 3B slide 6 was removed.

images.format: whole slides rendered at 1400px, JPEG q85 or PNG whichever is smaller, named slide-N by PDF page number, or with a per-deck prefix (backprop-N, 3a-N, 3b-N) where a lecture has more than one deck
images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lecture 1: 45 of 110 pages. Lecture 2: 15 of deck 02's 95 pages (slide-N) and 3 of the 14-page handwritten backprop example (backprop-N), in one directory. Lecture 3: 9 of deck 3A's 44 pages (3a-N) and 4 of deck 3B's 29 (3b-N), in one directory. Not rendered: slides with an OCW exclusion notice, deck 3A slides 24-25 (which reuse figures deck 3B excludes), superseded build steps and repeats, transcribed tables, single-box text diagrams, logistics and text-only slides; the lists are in BUILD_LOG.md. No lecture after 3 is in this KB yet, so none has images.

caveats: Slide numbers are PDF page numbers. Some lecture 1 pages visibly print stale numbers from an older deck (page 13 prints 20), and lecture 2's deck prints N+1 from page 50 on; the slide files list them.

Catalog video titles overstate coverage: video 1 ends before training, video 2 shows only the four-line Keras model definition, and video 3, titled for convolutional networks, never reaches them (they are in deck 04).
Lecture 2's backprop example is a handwritten deck that the video points to but does not present; it is transcribed from the handwriting in its own slide file.
Figure checks were done by the parent model on rendered images, not by an independent agent.
Lecture 2 renders slides 55-58 and 69, which reproduce plots from a web page whose gradient-descent figures OCW excludes on slide 75 only; LICENSE.md names the source.
Lecture 3 spans two decks, cited as 'deck 3A, slide N' and 'deck 3B, slide N'; deck 3B prints N+1 from page 16 where it prints a number.
The course's Colab notebooks are not published on OCW. Lecture 3's two Colab walkthroughs are described from the lecturer's narration only.
